Article 17 TFEU: Dialogue with churches, and religious and philosophical organisations

Briefing 20-11-2026

In an effort to give a more human dimension to the European project, Jacques Delors' conference in 1994 sought the 'soul of Europe'. This led to Article 17 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union providing for a regular dialogue between the EU institutions and confessional and non-confessional organisations. As a result, the European Parliament holds topical debates twice per year with representatives of churches and philosophical and humanist organisations.

Briefing 20-11-2026

The European Commission is expected to publish a proposal for an EU quantum act on 24 November 2026. The proposal should address the potential of new quantum technologies and the challenges they pose. Adoption procedure for the 2028-2034 MFF

At a Glance 19-11-2026

This note provides a short overview of the adoption procedure for the 2028-2034 multiannual financial framework (MFF). The MFF determines the expenditure for the major policy priorities of the European Union. The European Parliament holds a right of consent on the MFF Regulation, which requires unanimity in the Council of the European Union.
